name: Phase-sequence or voltage-balance protection
summary: Supervises phase order or voltage imbalance using the selected device's voltage inputs.
description: Supervises phase order or voltage imbalance using the selected device's voltage inputs.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the three-phase voltage measurement circuit. The associated drawing should trace the phase-order or imbalance alarm/trip destination; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the three-phase voltage measurement circuit.
Trace the phase-order or imbalance alarm/trip destination.
drawingChecklist: Label the three-phase voltage measurement circuit.
Cross-reference the phase-order or imbalance alarm/trip destination.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Voltage-based supervision 47 differs from current-unbalance function 46.
